name: com.tomergoldst.timekeeper.core.StatusReviewAlarmJobService
description: The TimeKeeper alarm scheduling SDK by Tomer Goldstein runs this Service as a maintenance task about every five to six hours. It checks that a backup alarm is still scheduled and, if it is missing, schedules it again and restores the app’s saved alarms.
disableEffect: If TimeKeeper alarms need recovery, disabling this Service can leave them unscheduled and app actions may be missed.
